fund_type: Open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in large cap stocks

lock_in_period.description: Nil. This open-ended equity fund carries no statutory lock-in period.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Top 100 Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 1.08%.

exit_load.description: An exit load of 1.00% is levied if units are redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from allotment. Nil exit load after 1 year.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment is ₹100 per installment. The minimum initial and additional lump sum investment is ₹100.

taxation.short_term_capital_gains: STCG is taxed at 20% if redeemed within 12 months.
taxation.long_term_capital_gains: LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year is taxed at 12.5% without indexation if held for more than 12 months.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Obtain account and tax statements online through Groww (Reports section) or by visiting the HDFC Mutual Fund investor service portal.
operations.folio_lookup: Viewable in the Groww dashboard under Holdings or on the CAMS/KFintech CAS statement.
